description: LTB AGVis is an open-source software tool listed in best-of-ps, a ranked list of open-source power-system-analysis projects under the section "visualisation tool", published or maintained by CURENT (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Geographical Visualization for Power Grid; CURENT LTB. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "visualisation tool". It reports 10 GitHub stars and a last repository update on 2026-03-09. Implementation language: Python. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0 (as given in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inspecting and presenting power-system models and results. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-best-of-ps.
